production.format_and_medium.summary: Records must be provided in a form both convenient and practical for use by the requester, if it is equally convenient for the public body to provide them in that form.

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: A public body is not required to create an electronic version of a public record when one does not exist in order to fulfill a records request.

eligibility.incarcerated_requester_exclu.summary: The right to inspect/copy does not extend to individuals serving a sentence of imprisonment in a state, county, or federal correctional facility (whether in South Carolina or elsewhere); their constitutionally protected rights, including the right to call for evidence in a criminal prosecution, a…

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person (individual, corporation, partnership, firm, organization, or association) has a right to inspect, copy, or receive an electronic transmission of any public record of a public body, subject to exemptions and reasonable time/place rules.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester need not state a reason or purpose for the request; the statutory right to inspect/copy is unconditioned on purpose.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no residency or state-citizenship requirement to request records; the right runs to any "person" without qualification as to residence.

fee.waiver.summary: Fees may not be charged for examination and review to determine if documents are subject to disclosure.

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: If written notification of the determination is neither mailed, electronically transmitted, nor personally delivered to the requester within the statutory time, the request must be considered approved as to nonexempt records or information.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: Deemed approved upon expiry of the 10/20 business-day determination deadline without notice

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: Exemptions from disclosure under § 30-4-40 or other state/federal law are not waived by the public body's failure to respond within the statutory time.

response.extension_grounds.summary: The response, determination, and production deadlines may be extended by written mutual agreement of the public body and the requesting party, which agreement shall not be unreasonably withheld.

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: Fees for copies may not exceed the prevailing commercial rate for the producing of copies.

fee.labor_charge.summary: A public body may establish and collect reasonable fees not to exceed the actual cost of the search, retrieval, and redaction of records.

The fee for search, retrieval, or redaction shall not exceed the prorated hourly salary of the lowest paid employee who, in the custodian's reasonable discretion, has the necessary skill and training to perform the request.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: Records must be furnished at the lowest possible cost to the person requesting them.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: If records are not in electronic format and the public body agrees to produce them electronically, it may charge for the staff time required to transfer the documents to electronic format.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: Copy charges may not be applied to records that are transmitted in an electronic format.
